summary: Analyze health research data in Stata, calculate epidemiological measures, and document results. Explore the five-day foundation course.
lede: Epidemiological data analysis with Stata helps public health and research staff turn health datasets into interpretable findings. Participants practise defining analytic cohorts and denominators, checking data quality, calculating incidence and prevalence, and interpreting risk ratios, odds ratios and introductory regression results. They also document missing-data checks and reproducible analyses, explaining how study data support a finding and where its limitations lie.
audienceIntro: This foundation course suits professionals who work with health research or surveillance data and need to conduct or review routine epidemiological analysis in Stata. It is designed for roles that make decisions about case definitions, denominators, study measures, and interpretation.
audience: Public health programme officers using rate tables
prerequisites: No prior Stata programming is required. Basic familiarity with epidemiological terms and health research data is helpful. Coding or programming is not required for completion.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
